类 JobStorage

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.storage.JobStorage
public class JobStorage extends Object
Text file storage manager for job data.

Stores job information in pipe-delimited text line format, supporting job creation, update, archiving, and lookup, along with date and timestamp parsing.
